lied.speaker: uncle-bright
lied.text: Ah, the owner of the 'yesterday' phone. The gate still closes at ten, {name}.

returned.speaker: uncle-bright
returned.text: Kojo looked lighter when he left. Thank you for that. The gate closes at ten, {name}.

gate.speaker: uncle-bright
gate.text: The gate closes at ten o'clock, {name}. After that, it's me you'll be begging.
